parsed.post: Discarding the halving of TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE; the previous experiment (0.8475) was worse than my best (0.8444). It seems 262k is indeed a more stable sweet spot than 131k for depth 6. Next, I'll try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to see if a slightly higher rate helps convergence.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.05 to accelerate convergence after the batch size reduction regressed.
